# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
  unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Motivation
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected range is <2.9.4 (and 3.0.0–3.1.0); fixed in 2.9.4 (and 3.1.0). We bump to 2.9.4 to stay on the same major version line and minimize the change surface.

Also adds a changelog entry under Unreleased.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.

## Review
Requesting review from @alex (code owner approval required for merge to main).
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
